name: Melhor Envio
description: Connect your Melhor Envio account so the agent can answer where-is-my-order questions: shipment status, carrier, tracking code and link, posting and delivery dates, and parcels that look stuck.

melhorenvio_track_shipment.label: Track shipment
melhorenvio_track_shipment.description: Looks up a shipment by tracking code, Melhor Envio protocol or shipment id: status, carrier, tracking link, dates and whether it looks stuck.

melhorenvio_find_customer_shipments.label: Find customer shipments
melhorenvio_find_customer_shipments.description: Finds the shipments sent to a verified customer by their CPF or CNPJ, most recent first.

accessToken.label: Access token
accessToken.description: Token generated in your Melhor Envio panel (Integrações → Permissões de acesso) with permission to view shipping labels.

contactEmail.label: Contact email
contactEmail.description: Technical contact email. Melhor Envio requires one on every API request so they can reach whoever runs the integration.

staleTrackingDays.label: Stale tracking (days)
staleTrackingDays.description: Treat a posted shipment as stuck when it has not been delivered after more than this many days.
